buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. TERMS AND CONDITIONS : 1] Firm has to provide service as per Scope of Work - Annexure-A. 2] Payment Terms: Payment shall be made on a monthly basis based on Job Completion Certificate issued by the QC section. 3] The Bid will also be governed by GeM GTC (General Terms & Conditions). 4] Techno commercial terms like specification, deviations, freight charges, insurance, taxes, duties & othe r expenses if any should be specifically indicated in the offer. 5] In case, there is any amendment by Govt, in taxes/levies/duties the same will be revived in the line with the AVNL Procurement Manual - 2024 (Stores & Services) and amendment issued from time to time. 6] Other terms & condition shall be within overall ambit of AVNL Procurement Manual - 2024 (Stores & Ser vices) and amendment issued from time to time. 7] The firm has to submit ink signed and Stamped in each page of Scope of work and attached along with Bid for Technical consideration of their offer. 8] Penalty Clause: As per Terms and Conditions of the contract mentioned in scope of work attached alo ng with bid. (Point No. 1 of General Terms and Conditions of the Contract of Scope of Work Annexure-A) 9] Experience & Turnover Criteria(MSE & Startup) a) Experience criteria : "The firm must have past 3 years of Experience for similar type of work/service c ontracts in Govt. Dept /PSU. Firm must provide satisfactory service/Job Completion certificate as Experienc e failing which technical evaluation will not be considered." b) TURNOVER : The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during last 3 financial year, ending on 31st March of previous financial year, should be Rs. 7.40 Lakhs (minimum) & to be indicated in t he bid document. The Documentary evidence in the form of certified audited balance sheet for relevant pe riod or a certificate from chartered accountant/cost accountant indicating the turnover details for the relev ant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in r/o the completed financial years After the date of constitution sha ll be taken into account for these criteria. The firm has to submit Year wise Turnover for last 3 Years in sep arate Sheet with audited by certified chartered accountant/cost accountant. 10] PRE-BID VISIT : Before Quoting the tender, firm must visit MTPF site for exact quantum of work & acquiring detailed analysis of the work. Offer of only those firms who have completed pre bid visit at MTPF-Ambarnath shall be considered for evaluation of bid) Pre Bid visit is man datory. Contact: Shri Kiran V.
